integrity: All 2^21 point selections tested in two separate coordinate models; exact identity of all 17 bivariate coefficients and total checked. Six required documents and executable/source data included.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite, 42-vertex Desarguesian projective-plane incidence graph only. No claim of infinite-family formula or independent scholarly audit. Prior literature establishes the minimum cardinality; the complete bivariate spectrum is the assessed addition.
title: Complete bivariate independent-domination spectrum of the quaternary projective-plane incidence graph
